details:
SpaceWell AI – Smarter Health, Safer Space Missions

Project Overview

SpaceWell AI is an AI-powered health and wellness platform designed to support astronaut well-being during long-duration space missions. It focuses on four important areas: physical health monitoring, nutrition management, mental wellness and AI-powered health assistance.

Problem Statement

Astronauts face several health challenges during space missions, including changes in physical health, limited nutritional resources, psychological stress and isolation. Maintaining overall well-being in these demanding environments requires accessible health information and continuous support.

Proposed Solution

SpaceWell AI brings multiple wellness capabilities together in one digital platform. It combines Google Gemini AI with health-monitoring features and rule-based alerts to provide an integrated wellness-support experience.

Key Features

  1. AI Health Assistant: Gemini-powered conversational assistance for health-related information and wellness guidance.
  2. Health Monitoring: A dashboard for viewing and monitoring selected health indicators.
  3. Smart Nutrition: Nutrition guidance and recommendations to support healthy dietary habits.
  4. Mental Wellness: Mental wellness support and stress-management guidance.
  5. Intelligent Alerts: Rule-based alerts for selected health indicators that may require attention.

Technology Stack

  • Google AI Studio – Application development.
  • Google Gemini AI – Artificial intelligence integration.
  • Web technologies – User interface and application functionality.
  • Rule-based logic – Health alert functionality.

Innovation

SpaceWell AI integrates physical health, nutrition and mental wellness into one platform rather than treating them as separate concerns. Its combination of conversational AI and rule-based monitoring provides a unified approach to digital wellness support.

Expected Impact

The project aims to support astronaut well-being and contribute to healthier, safer long-duration space exploration. Its approach may also inspire future digital wellness applications on Earth.

Future Scope

Future development includes integration with NASA spaceflight health datasets, wearable devices, improved health analytics and expert-validated personalized recommendations.

SpaceWell AI – Smarter Health, Safer Space Missions.
